definitions.gloss: amber color; caramel color; honey color
definitions.explanation: A translucent golden-brown color resembling that of traditional Japanese hard candy. Commonly used to describe slowly caramelized onions, varnished wood, or aged objects.

examples.japanese: {玉|たま}ねぎ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飴色|あめいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{炒|いた}める→炒める：01879_itameru⟧。
examples.english: Fry the onions until they turn caramel-colored.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{飴色|あめいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{輝|かがや}いていた→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧。
examples.english: The old furniture glowed an amber color.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使|つか}い{込|こ}んだ→使い込む：07876_tsukaikomu⟧⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧{飴色|あめいろ}になっていた。
examples.english: My grandfather's well-used desk had taken on a beautiful amber color from years of use.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{飴|あめ}→飴：00687_ame⟧ (candy) + ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ (color). Often signals warmth, age, and quality — used positively for both cooked foods and well-aged wooden objects.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飴色|あめいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{玉|たま}ねぎ: caramelized onions
- {飴色|あめいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{炒|いた}める→炒める：01879_itameru⟧: to fry until caramel-colored
- {飴色|あめいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧: amber-colored furniture

SIMILAR WORDS:
- きつね⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧: golden brown — describes the color of well-fried food (toast, tempura, fried chicken); lighter than {飴色|あめいろ}
- {琥珀色|こはくいろ}: amber color — more formal/literary; often used for whiskey, tea, and gemstones
